sections.description: Adds to GWN e-Transfer: the WooCommerce → e-Transfers inbox (every order waiting on payment, with search and one-click Mark paid) and business-day payment deadlines.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

First release of the Pro add-on.

Added

  • WooCommerce → e-Transfers inbox (moved from the free plugin).
  • Business-day payment deadlines with a closing time; deadline shown as a date.
  • Signed updates for this add-on and, until it's on WordPress.org, for GWN e-Transfer.
